Given:

\n\n

Height of the cone (h) = 24 cm

\n\n

Radius of the base (r) = 10.5 cm

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Volume of the cone V = (1)/(3) π r2 h

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Substitute the given values into the formula:

\n\n

⇒ Volume V = (1)/(3) π (10.5)2 (24)

\n\n

⇒ Volume V = (1)/(3) π (110.25) (24)

\n\n

⇒ Volume V = (1)/(3) π (2646)

\n\n

⇒ Volume V = 882 π

\n\n

Using π ≈ 3.14:

\n\n

⇒ Volume V = 882 × 3.14

\n\n

⇒ Volume V ≈ 2772.48 cm3

\n\n

The volume of the cone is approximately 2772 cm3.

Given:

\n\n

Total amount = Rs. 7400

\n\n

Ratio among A, B, and C = 9 : 12 : 16

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Share of B = (Ratio of B / Sum of Ratios) × Total Amount

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Sum of ratios = 9 + 12 + 16

\n\n

Sum of ratios = 37

\n\n

Share of B = (12 / 37) × 7400

\n\n

Share of B = 12 × (7400 / 37)

\n\n

Share of B = 12 × 200

\n\n

Share of B = 2400

\n\n

The share of B is Rs. 2400.

\n", "hn": "

दिया गया है:

\n\n

कुल राशि = ₹ 7400

\n\n

A, B और C के बीच अनुपात = 9 : 12 : 16

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

B का हिस्सा = (B का अनुपात / अनुपातों का योग) × कुल राशि

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

अनुपातों का योग = 9 + 12 + 16

\n\n

अनुपातों का योग = 37

\n\n

B का हिस्सा = (12 / 37) × 7400

\n\n

B का हिस्सा = 12 × (7400 / 37)

\n\n

B का हिस्सा = 12 × 200

\n\n

B का हिस्सा = 2400

\n\n

B का हिस्सा ₹ 2400 है।

\n\n

\n\n

B యొక్క వాటా రూ. 2400.

Given:

\n\n

Average of 28 observations = 53

\n\n

Average of first 11 observations = 54

\n\n

Average of last 18 observations = 52.5

\n\n

Formula Used:

\n\n

Average = Sum of observations / Number of observations

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

Sum of 28 observations = 53 × 28 = 1484

\n\n

Sum of first 11 observations = 54 × 11 = 594

\n\n

Sum of last 18 observations = 945

\n\n

The 11th observation is = 594 + 945 - 1484 = 55

\n\n

The 11th observation is 55.
